The structure of Na2Co4O6 (NaCo2O3) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 12 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co centers in octahedral coordination by six O neighbors, while Na centers have a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 O neighbors. Co octahedra share edges with one another and also share faces with Na 12-vertex polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
